translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat men's genital ulcers (陰瘡), women's erosion of the genitals (陰蝕), as well as food-injury disease with constant desire to sleep. One name is 通石; it is the root of Yin'nie (殷孽), of such color.
translator_notes: 色 at end likely describes appearance; original truncated.
